title: iPSC Editing with TALENs
author: Ruilin Tian
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8dahs2e
materials: Aspirate supernatant and resuspend cells in Stemflex.
Put the plate in incubator and culture overnight.

steps.title: Pre-coat 6-well Plate
steps.instruction: Pre-coat a 6-well plate with Matrigel diluted 1:50 with Knockout DMEM.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of diluted Matrigel to each well.

steps.title: Prepare iPSCs for Singularization
steps.instruction: Grow iPSCs until they reach approximately 85% confluency in one well of a 6-well plate or larger format.

substeps.instruction: Remove old medium.
Wash iPSCs with 1x DPBS.

steps.title: Singularize and Collect Cells
steps.instruction: Singularize the cells and collect them in a conical tube.

substeps.instruction: Gently pipette cells up and down several times to singularize.
Add DPBS to a 15 mL conical tube and add the cells lifted in Accutase.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Count Cells
steps.instruction: Spin down the cells and determine the cell count.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 200 x g for 5 minutes.
Perform cell count.

steps.title: Re-seed iPSCs
steps.instruction: Re-seed the cells into the pre-coated 6-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Remove the Matrigel from the pre-coated plate.
Add an appropriate amount of Stemflex medium containing Rock inhibitor (1000x).
Seed 0.5 M cells so that they reach ~60% confluency the following day.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Transfection
steps.instruction: Refresh the media the day after seeding.

substeps.instruction: Change the media with new E8 media.

steps.title: Prepare TALEN Transfection Mixes
steps.instruction: Prepare two separate tubes for the transfection mixture.

substeps.instruction: Tube 1: Mix 100 µL Opti-Mem and 10 µL Lipofectamine Stem Reagent.
Tube 2: Mix 100 µL Opti-Mem and a DNA mix (0.5 µg – 5.0 µg total). Optimized TALENS ratio: 1.5 µg total, consisting of 0.75 µg Plasmid of choice, 0.75 µg TALENS L, and 0.3 µg TALENS R, BCL-XL.

steps.title: Formulate Transfection Complex
steps.instruction: Combine the DNA and reagent mixtures.

substeps.instruction: Add Tube 2 to Tube 1 and mix well.
Incubate the mixture for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Transfect iPSCs
steps.instruction: Apply the transfection mixture to the cells.

substeps.instruction: Add the entire mixture to the cells in the 6-well plate.

steps.title: Post-Transfection Recovery
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells and refresh the media.

substeps.instruction: Incubate overnight.
Change the media to Stemflex the next day.

steps.title: Expand and Passage Cells
steps.instruction: Expand the cells into a larger format for selection.

substeps.instruction: If confluent, passage and expand cells into a 10 cm plate.
Once confluent in the 10 cm plate, proceed to the selection protocol.

steps.title: Lift Cells for Selection
steps.instruction: Prepare cells for the next phase by lifting them from the plate.

substeps.instruction: Let cells sit in the incubator for at least 20 minutes.
Add Accutase for 3 to 5 minutes to lift the cells.
